name: Auto Materials
author: Tequila
description: Puts library materials on every part when a model comes in, whatever it is called: by its name - in English, German, French, Spanish or Italian, CAD shorthand or a fastener standard - its CAD material, description, layer and assemblies; by what you gave parts of the same name before; and for the rest by shape and colour: see-through parts glass, small repeated parts hardware, rods steel, anything else a moulded finish in its own colour. Plastics keep the model's colours. Your own rules on top, a preview of what decided what, or the whole scene at a click.

fields.label: And rules from a CSV file (words, material)
Then Tequila's own rules (about 60, in five languages, with CAD shorthand and fastener standards)
Read the CAD file's material names, descriptions, layers and the assemblies too, not only the parts' names
Guess the rest from shape and colour: see-through parts glass, small repeated parts hardware, rods steel, anything else a moulded finish in its own colour
Plastics and paints keep the colour the model gave the part
Leave parts that already have a library material
Apply them when a model is imported
Learn from the materials you choose: a project you save teaches it, so parts with the same names get them next time
